    Walks in graph forms without cycles #

    NoCore q: every nonempty set has a point with at most one neighbour inside it (the graph of q is a forest). Then non-backtracking walks have distinct points (nb_inj). walk b n starts at b, steps to n, then keeps going away from where it came; IsStop b n k says it passes through points of degree two until step k.

    source

    Prop

    The graph of q has no cycle.
